title: REST API Quick Tester
description: Send GET/POST/PUT/DELETE requests from your browser and inspect status, timing, headers and body.
howto: Enter the endpoint URL and choose the method.
Add headers and a request body if needed.
Click Send and inspect status, time, headers and body.
Note: only CORS-enabled endpoints can be tested from a browser.

faqs.q: Why do I get a network/CORS error?
faqs.a: Browsers block cross-origin requests unless the server sends CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin). The request never left your browser — this is a browser security rule, not a tool bug.

faqs.q: Is my data sent anywhere else?
faqs.a: No — requests go directly from your browser to the URL you entered.
Yes — add an Authorization header. Credentials are only sent to the URL you typed.
Wall-clock time from fetch start to the full response body being read, in milliseconds.
